title: Willow Grove subdivision
goal: Show four serviced lots, roads, setbacks, and utility easement.

rubric.must: Four distinct labelled lots are visibly enclosed within the tract.
Willow Grove Drive and Cedar Lane visibly cross between the lots.
Front and rear setbacks are visibly labelled inside Lot 1.
A continuous 10 ft utility easement is visibly marked through the subdivision.
North arrow, scale, and overall dimension are visible.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all five rules, while the picture fails the required crossing roads and continuous 10 ft utility easement and omits the overall dimension.
